verses.text_uthmani: وَٱلطُّورِ

trs.20: By the mount
trs.85: By the mountain,
trs.22: By the Mount (of Revelation);
trs.203: By the Tûr (Mount)

verses.text_uthmani: وَكِتَـٰبٍ مَّسْطُورٍ

trs.20: And [by] a Book inscribed<sup foot_note=197428>1</sup>
trs.85: by a Scripture inscribed
trs.22: By a Decree inscribed
trs.203: And by a Book Inscribed

verses.text_uthmani: فِى رَقٍّ مَّنشُورٍ

trs.20: In parchment spread open
trs.85: in unrolled parch-ment,
trs.22: In a Scroll unfolded;
trs.203: In parchment unrolled.

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱلْبَيْتِ ٱلْمَعْمُورِ

trs.20: And [by] the frequented House<sup foot_note=197429>1</sup>
trs.85: by the much-visited House,
trs.22: By the much-frequented Fane;
trs.203: And by Al-Bait-ul-Ma‘mûr<sup foot_note=154937>1</sup> (the house over the heavens parallel to the Ka‘bah at Makkah, continuously visited by the angels).

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱلسَّقْفِ ٱلْمَرْفُوعِ

trs.20: And [by] the ceiling [i.e., heaven] raised high
trs.85: by the raised canopy,
trs.22: By the Canopy Raised High;
trs.203: And by the roof raised high (i.e. the heaven).

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱلْبَحْرِ ٱلْمَسْجُورِ

trs.20: And [by] the sea set on fire,<sup foot_note=197430>1</sup>
trs.85: by the ocean ever filled,
trs.22: And by the Ocean filled with Swell;-
trs.203: And by the sea kept filled (or it will be fire kindled on the Day of Resurrection).

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّكَ لَوَٰقِعٌ

trs.20: Indeed, the punishment of your Lord will occur.
trs.85: [Prophet], your Lord’s punishment is coming––
trs.22: Verily, the Doom of thy Lord will indeed come to pass;-
trs.203: Verily, the Torment of your Lord will surely come to pass.

verses.text_uthmani: مَّا لَهُۥ مِن دَافِعٍ

trs.20: Of it there is no preventer.
trs.85: it cannot be put off––
trs.22: There is none can avert it;-
trs.203: There is none that can avert it.

verses.text_uthmani: يَوْمَ تَمُورُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ مَوْرًا

trs.20: On the Day the heaven will sway with circular motion
trs.85: on the Day when the sky sways back and forth
trs.22: On the Day when the firmament will be in dreadful commotion.
trs.203: On the Day when the heaven will shake with a dreadful shaking,

verses.text_uthmani: وَتَسِيرُ ٱلْجِبَالُ سَيْرًا

trs.20: And the mountains will pass on, departing<sup foot_note=197431>1</sup> -
trs.85: and the mountains float away.
trs.22: And the mountains will fly hither and thither.
trs.203: And the mountains will move away with a (horrible) movement.

verses.text_uthmani: فَوَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ

trs.20: Then woe, that Day, to the deniers,
trs.85: Woe on that Day to those who deny the Truth,
trs.22: Then woe that Day to those that treat (Truth) as Falsehood;-
trs.203: Then woe that Day to the beliers.<sup foot_note=154938>1</sup>

verses.text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِى خَوْضٍ يَلْعَبُونَ

trs.20: Who are in [empty] discourse amusing themselves.
trs.85: who amuse themselves with idle chatter:
trs.22: That play (and paddle) in shallow trifles.
trs.203: Who are playing in falsehood<sup foot_note=154939>1</sup>.

verses.text_uthmani: يَوْمَ يُدَعُّونَ إِلَىٰ نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ دَعًّا

trs.20: The Day they are thrust toward the fire of Hell with a [violent] thrust, [its angels will say],
trs.85: on that Day they will be thrust into the Fire of Hell.
trs.22: That Day shall they be thrust down to the Fire of Hell, irresistibly.
trs.203: The Day when they will be pushed down by force to the Fire of Hell, with a horrible, forceful pushing.

verses.text_uthmani: هَـٰذِهِ ٱلنَّارُ ٱلَّتِى كُنتُم بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ

trs.20: "This is the Fire which you used to deny.
trs.85: ‘This is the Fire you used to deny.
trs.22: "This:, it will be said, "Is the Fire,- which ye were wont to deny!
trs.203: This is the Fire which you used to belie.

verses.text_uthmani: أَفَسِحْرٌ هَـٰذَآ أَمْ أَنتُمْ لَا تُبْصِرُونَ

trs.20: Then is this magic, or do you not see?
trs.85: So is this sorcery? Do you still not see it?
trs.22: "Is this then a fake, or is it ye that do not see?
trs.203: Is this magic, or do you not see?

verses.text_uthmani: ٱصْلَوْهَا فَٱصْبِرُوٓا۟ أَوْ لَا تَصْبِرُوا۟ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيْكُمْ ۖ إِنَّمَا تُجْزَوْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ

trs.20: [Enter to] burn therein; then be patient or impatient - it is all the same for you. You are only being recompensed [for] what you used to do."
trs.85: Burn in it––it makes no difference whether you bear it patiently or not–– you are only being repaid for what you have done.’
trs.22: "Burn ye therein: the same is it to you whether ye bear it with patience, or not: Ye but receive the recompense of your (own) deeds."
trs.203: Taste you therein its heat and whether you are patient of it or impatient of it, it is all the same. You are only being requited for what you used to do.

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ وَنَعِيمٍ

trs.20: Indeed, the righteous will be in gardens and pleasure,
trs.85: Those who were mindful of God are in Gardens and in bliss,
trs.22: As to the Righteous, they will be in Gardens, and in Happiness,-
trs.203: Verily, the Muttaqûn (the pious. See V.2:2) will be in Gardens (Paradise), and Delight.

verses.text_uthmani: فَـٰكِهِينَ بِمَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ وَوَقَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْجَحِيمِ

trs.20: Enjoying what their Lord has given them, and their Lord protected them from the punishment of Hellfire.
trs.85: rejoicing in their Lord’s gifts: He has saved them from the torment of the Blaze,
trs.22: Enjoying the (Bliss) which their Lord hath bestowed on them, and their Lord shall deliver them from the Penalty of the Fire.
trs.203: Enjoying in that which their Lord has bestowed on them, and (the fact that) their Lord saved them from the torment of the blazing Fire.

verses.text_uthmani: كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ

trs.20: [They will be told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you used to do."
trs.85: ‘Eat and drink with healthy enjoyment as a reward for what you have done.’
trs.22: (To them will be said:) "Eat and drink ye, with profit and health, because of your (good) deeds."
trs.203: "Eat and drink with happiness because of what you used to do."

verses.text_uthmani: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍ مَّصْفُوفَةٍ ۖ وَزَوَّجْنَـٰهُم بِحُورٍ عِينٍ

trs.20: They will be reclining on thrones lined up, and We will marry them to fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes.
trs.85: They are comfortably seated on couches arranged in rows; We pair them with beautiful-eyed maidens;
trs.22: They will recline (with ease) on Thrones (of dignity) arranged in ranks; and We shall join them to Companions, with beautiful big and lustrous eyes.
trs.203: They will recline (with ease) on thrones arranged in ranks. And We shall marry them to Hûr: (female, fair ones) with wide lovely eyes.<sup foot_note=154940>1</sup>

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَٱتَّبَعَتْهُمْ ذُرِّيَّتُهُم بِإِيمَـٰنٍ أَلْحَقْنَا بِهِمْ ذُرِّيَّتَهُمْ وَمَآ أَلَتْنَـٰهُم مِّنْ عَمَلِهِم مِّن شَىْءٍ ۚ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍۭ بِمَا كَسَبَ رَهِينٌ

trs.20: And those who believed and whose descendants followed them in faith - We will join with them their descendants, and We will not deprive them of anything of their deeds.<sup foot_note=197433>1</sup> Every person, for what he earned, is retained.<sup foot_note=197432>2</sup>
trs.85: We unite the believers with their offspring who followed them in faith–– We do not deny them any of the rewards for their deeds: each person is in pledge for his own deeds––
trs.22: And those who believe and whose families follow them in Faith,- to them shall We join their families: Nor shall We deprive them (of the fruit) of aught of their works: (Yet) is each individual in pledge for his deeds.
trs.203: And those who believe and whose offspring follow them in Faith: to them shall We join their offspring, and We shall not decrease the reward of their deeds in anything. Every person is a pledge for that which he has earned.

verses.text_uthmani: وَأَمْدَدْنَـٰهُم بِفَـٰكِهَةٍ وَلَحْمٍ مِّمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ

trs.20: And We will provide them with fruit and meat from whatever they desire.
trs.85: We provide them with any fruit or meat they desire.
trs.22: And We shall bestow on them, of fruit and meat, anything they shall desire.
trs.203: And We shall provide them with fruit and meat such as they desire.

verses.text_uthmani: يَتَنَـٰزَعُونَ فِيهَا كَأْسًا لَّا لَغْوٌ فِيهَا وَلَا تَأْثِيمٌ

trs.20: They will exchange with one another a cup [of wine] wherein [results] no ill speech or commission of sin.
trs.85: They pass around a cup which does not lead to any idle talk or sin.
trs.22: They shall there exchange, one with another, a (loving) cup free of frivolity, free of all taint of ill.
trs.203: There they shall pass from hand to hand a (wine) cup, free from any Laghw (dirty, false, evil vain talk between them), and free from sin<sup foot_note=154941>1</sup> (because it will be lawful for them to drink).

translation.text: They will pass to one another

verses.text_uthmani: ۞ وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ غِلْمَانٌ لَّهُمْ كَأَنَّهُمْ لُؤْلُؤٌ مَّكْنُونٌ

trs.20: There will circulate among them [servant] boys [especially] for them, as if they were pearls well-protected.
trs.85: Devoted youths like hidden pearls wait on them.
trs.22: Round about them will serve, (devoted) to them, young male servants (handsome) as Pearls well-guarded.
trs.203: And there will go round boy-servants of theirs, to serve them as if they were preserved pearls.

verses.text_uthmani: وَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ

trs.20: And they will approach one another, inquiring of each other.
trs.85: They turn to one another and say,
trs.22: They will advance to each other, engaging in mutual enquiry.
trs.203: And some of them draw near to others, questioning.

verses.text_uthmani: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا كُنَّا قَبْلُ فِىٓ أَهْلِنَا مُشْفِقِينَ

trs.20: They will say, "Indeed, we were previously among our people fearful [of displeasing Allāh].
trs.85: ‘When we were still with our families [on earth] we used to live in fear––
trs.22: They will say: "Aforetime, we were not without fear for the sake of our people.
trs.203: Saying: "Aforetime, we were afraid (of the punishment of Allâh) in the midst of our families.

verses.text_uthmani: فَمَنَّ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْنَا وَوَقَىٰنَا عَذَابَ ٱلسَّمُومِ

trs.20: So Allāh conferred favor upon us and protected us from the punishment of the Scorching Fire.
trs.85: God has been gracious to us and saved us from the torment of intense heat-
trs.22: "But Allah has been good to us, and has delivered us from the Penalty of the Scorching Wind.
trs.203: "So Allâh has been gracious to us, and has saved us from the torment of the Fire.

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّا كُنَّا مِن قَبْلُ نَدْعُوهُ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْبَرُّ ٱلرَّحِيمُ

trs.20: Indeed, we used to supplicate<sup foot_note=197434>1</sup> Him before. Indeed, it is He who is the Beneficent, the Merciful."
trs.85: We used to pray to Him: He is the Good, the Merciful One.’
trs.22: "Truly, we did call unto Him from of old: truly it is He, the Beneficent, the Merciful!"
trs.203: "Verily, We used to invoke Him (Alone and none else) before. Verily, He is Al-Barr (the Most Subtle, Kind, Courteous, and Generous), the Most Merciful."<sup foot_note=154942>1</sup>

verses.text_uthmani: فَذَكِّرْ فَمَآ أَنتَ بِنِعْمَتِ رَبِّكَ بِكَاهِنٍ وَلَا مَجْنُونٍ

trs.20: So remind, [O Muḥammad], for you are not, by the favor of your Lord, a soothsayer or a madman.
trs.85: So [Prophet] remind [people]. By the grace of your Lord [Prophet], you are neither oracle nor madman.
trs.22: Therefore proclaim thou the praises (of thy Lord): for by the Grace of thy Lord, thou art no (vulgar) soothsayer, nor art thou one possessed.
trs.203: Therefore, remind (mankind of Islâmic Monotheism, O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم). By the Grace of Allâh, you are neither a soothsayer, nor a madman.

verses.text_uthmani: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ شَاعِرٌ نَّتَرَبَّصُ بِهِۦ رَيْبَ ٱلْمَنُونِ

trs.20: Or do they say [of you], "A poet for whom we await a misfortune of time"?<sup foot_note=197435>1</sup>
trs.85: If they say, ‘He is only a poet: we shall await his fate,’
trs.22: Or do they say:- "A Poet! we await for him some calamity (hatched) by Time!"
trs.203: Or do they say: "(Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) is a poet! We await for him some calamity by time!"

verses.text_uthmani: قُلْ تَرَبَّصُوا۟ فَإِنِّى مَعَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْمُتَرَبِّصِينَ

trs.20: Say, "Wait, for indeed I am, with you, among the waiters."
trs.85: say, ‘Wait if you wish; I too am waiting’-
trs.22: Say thou: "Await ye!- I too will wait along with you!"
trs.203: Say (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم to them): "Wait! I am with you among the waiters!"

verses.text_uthmani: أَمْ تَأْمُرُهُمْ أَحْلَـٰمُهُم بِهَـٰذَآ ۚ أَمْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ طَاغُونَ

trs.20: Or do their minds<sup foot_note=197436>1</sup> command them to [say] this, or are they a transgressing people?
trs.85: does their reason really tell them to do this, or are they simply insolent people?
trs.22: Is it that their faculties of understanding urge them to this, or are they but a people transgressing beyond bounds?
trs.203: Do their minds command them this [i.e. to tell a lie against you (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم)] or are they people transgressing all bounds?

verses.text_uthmani: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ تَقَوَّلَهُۥ ۚ بَل لَّا يُؤْمِنُونَ

trs.20: Or do they say, "He has made it up"? Rather, they do not believe.
trs.85: If they say, ‘He has made it up himself’- they certainly do not believe-
trs.22: Or do they say, "He fabricated the (Message)"? Nay, they have no faith!
trs.203: Or do they say: "He (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) has forged it (this Qur’ân)?" Nay! They believe not!

verses.text_uthmani: فَلْيَأْتُوا۟ بِحَدِيثٍ مِّثْلِهِۦٓ إِن كَانُوا۟ صَـٰدِقِينَ

trs.20: Then let them produce a statement like it, if they should be truthful.
trs.85: let them produce one like it, if what they say is true.
trs.22: Let them then produce a recital like unto it,- If (it be) they speak the truth!
trs.203: Let them then produce a recital like unto it (the Qur’ân) if they are truthful.

verses.text_uthmani: أَمْ خُلِقُوا۟ مِنْ غَيْرِ شَىْءٍ أَمْ هُمُ ٱلْخَـٰلِقُونَ

trs.20: Or were they created by nothing, or were they the creators [of themselves]?
trs.85: Were they created without any agent? Were they the creators?
trs.22: Were they created of nothing, or were they themselves the creators?
trs.203: Were they created by nothing? Or were they themselves the creators?

verses.text_uthmani: أَمْ خَلَقُوا۟ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ ۚ بَل لَّا يُوقِنُونَ

trs.20: Or did they create the heavens and the earth? Rather, they are not certain.
trs.85: Did they create the heavens and the earth? No! They do not have faith.
trs.22: Or did they create the heavens and the earth? Nay, they have no firm belief.
trs.203: Or did they create the heavens and the earth? Nay, but they have no firm Belief.

verses.text_uthmani: أَمْ عِندَهُمْ خَزَآئِنُ رَبِّكَ أَمْ هُمُ ٱلْمُصَۣيْطِرُونَ

trs.20: Or have they the depositories [containing the provision] of your Lord? Or are they the controllers [of them]?
trs.85: Do they possess your Lord’s treasures or have control over them?
trs.22: Or are the Treasures of thy Lord with them, or are they the managers (of affairs)?
trs.203: Or are with them the treasures of your Lord? Or are they the tyrants with the authority to do as they like?

verses.text_uthmani: أَمْ لَهُمْ سُلَّمٌ يَسْتَمِعُونَ فِيهِ ۖ فَلْيَأْتِ مُسْتَمِعُهُم بِسُلْطَـٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ

trs.20: Or have they a stairway [into the heaven] upon which they listen? Then let their listener produce a clear authority [i.e., proof].
trs.85: Do they have a ladder to climb, in order to eavesdrop [on Heaven’s secrets]? Let their eavesdropper produce clear proof.
trs.22: Or have they a ladder, by which they can (climb up to heaven and) listen (to its secrets)? Then let (such a) listener of theirs produce a manifest proof.
trs.203: Or have they a stairway (to heaven), by means of which they listen (to the talks of the angels)? Then let their listener produce some manifest proof.

verses.text_uthmani: أَمْ لَهُ ٱلْبَنَـٰتُ وَلَكُمُ ٱلْبَنُونَ

trs.20: Or has He daughters while you have sons?
trs.85: Does God have daughters while you have sons?
trs.22: Or has He only daughters and ye have sons?
trs.203: Or has He (Allâh) only daughters and you have sons?

verses.text_uthmani: أَمْ تَسْـَٔلُهُمْ أَجْرًا فَهُم مِّن مَّغْرَمٍ مُّثْقَلُونَ

trs.20: Or do you, [O Muḥammad], ask of them a payment, so they are by debt burdened down?
trs.85: Do you [Prophet] demand a payment from them that would burden them with debt?
trs.22: Or is it that thou dost ask for a reward, so that they are burdened with a load of debt?-
trs.203: Or is it that you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) ask a wage from them (for your preaching of Islâmic Monotheism) so that they are burdened with a load of debt?

verses.text_uthmani: أَمْ عِندَهُمُ ٱلْغَيْبُ فَهُمْ يَكْتُبُونَ

trs.20: Or have they [knowledge of] the unseen, so they write [it] down?
trs.85: Do they have [access to] the unseen? Could they write it down?
trs.22: Or that the Unseen in it their hands, and they write it down?
trs.203: Or that the Ghaib (Unseen) is with them, and they write it down?

verses.text_uthmani: أَمْ يُرِيدُونَ كَيْدًا ۖ فَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلْمَكِيدُونَ

trs.20: Or do they intend a plan? But those who disbelieve - they are the object of a plan.
trs.85: Do they think they can ensnare you? It is the disbelievers who have been ensnared.
trs.22: Or do they intend a plot (against thee)? But those who defy Allah are themselves involved in a Plot!
trs.203: Or do they intend a plot (against you O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم)? But those who disbelieve (in the Oneness of Allâh - Islâmic Monotheism) are themselves plotted against!

verses.text_uthmani: أَمْ لَهُمْ إِلَـٰهٌ غَيْرُ ٱللَّهِ ۚ سُبْحَـٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ

trs.20: Or have they a deity other than Allāh? Exalted is Allāh above whatever they associate with Him.
trs.85: Do they really have another god besides God? God is far above anything they set alongside Him.
trs.22: Or have they a god other than Allah? Exalted is Allah far above the things they associate with Him!
trs.203: Or have they an ilâh (a god) other than Allâh? Glorified be Allâh from all that they ascribe as partners (to Him)<sup foot_note=154943>1</sup>

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ كِسْفًا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ سَاقِطًا يَقُولُوا۟ سَحَابٌ مَّرْكُومٌ

trs.20: And if they were to see a fragment from the sky falling,<sup foot_note=197437>1</sup> they would say, "[It is merely] clouds heaped up."
trs.85: Even if they saw a piece of heaven falling down on them, they would say, ‘Just a heap of clouds,’
trs.22: Were they to see a piece of the sky falling (on them), they would (only) say: "Clouds gathered in heaps!"
trs.203: And if they were to see a piece of the heaven falling down, they would say: "Clouds gathered in heaps!"

verses.text_uthmani: فَذَرْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ يُلَـٰقُوا۟ يَوْمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى فِيهِ يُصْعَقُونَ

trs.20: So leave them until they meet their Day in which they will be struck insensible -
trs.85: so leave them, Prophet, until they face the Day when they will be thunderstruck,
trs.22: So leave them alone until they encounter that Day of theirs, wherein they shall (perforce) swoon (with terror),-
trs.203: So leave them alone till they meet their Day, in which they will sink into a fainting (with horror).

verses.text_uthmani: يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِى عَنْهُمْ كَيْدُهُمْ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ

trs.20: The Day their plan will not avail them at all, nor will they be helped.
trs.85: the Day when their snares will be of no use to them, when they will get no help.
trs.22: The Day when their plotting will avail them nothing and no help shall be given them.
trs.203: The Day when their plotting shall not avail them at all nor will they be helped (i.e. they will receive their torment in Hell).

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ عَذَابًا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ

trs.20: And indeed, for those who have wronged is a punishment<sup foot_note=197438>1</sup> before that, but most of them do not know.
trs.85: Another punishment awaits the evildoers, though most of them do not realize it.
trs.22: And verily, for those who do wrong, there is another punishment besides this: But most of them understand not.
trs.203: And verily, for those who do wrong, there is another punishment (i.e. the torment in this world and in their graves)<sup foot_note=154944>1</sup> before this; but most of them know not. (Tafsir At-Tabarî).

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ فَإِنَّكَ بِأَعْيُنِنَا ۖ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ

trs.20: And be patient, [O Muḥammad], for the decision of your Lord, for indeed, you are in Our eyes [i.e., sight]. And exalt [Allāh] with praise of your Lord when you arise
trs.85: Wait patiently [Prophet] for your Lord’s judgement: you are under Our watchful eye. Celebrate the praise of your Lord when you rise.
trs.22: Now await in patience the command of thy Lord: for verily thou art in Our eyes: and celebrate the praises of thy Lord the while thou standest forth,
trs.203: So wait patiently (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) for the Decision of your Lord, for verily, you are under Our Eyes<sup foot_note=154945>1</sup>; and glorify the Praises of your Lord when you get up from sleep.

verses.text_uthmani: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَإِدْبَـٰرَ ٱلنُّجُومِ

trs.20: And in a part of the night exalt Him and after [the setting of] the stars.
trs.85: Glorify Him at night and at the fading of the stars.
trs.22: And for part of the night also praise thou Him,- and at the retreat of the stars!
trs.203: And in the nighttime also glorify His Praises - and at the setting of the stars.<sup foot_note=154946>1</sup>
